description: This file defines a Flutter widget for a user profile screen, allowing users to view and update their profile information and sign out.

classes.name: ProfileScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays user profile information and provides options to update profile details and sign out.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the ProfileScreen widget.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state, setting the initial value of the name TextEditingController based on the authenticated user's name.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes the TextEditingController to free resources.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the profile screen, displaying user info, a text field for updating name, and buttons to save changes or sign out.
